$comment: schema_version 1.0.0; tracks design/spec/run-capsule-v1.md. Validates capsule.yaml. Sub-file schemas: tool-call -> https://novafabric.io/schemas/tool-call.schema.json, model-call -> https://novafabric.io/schemas/model-call.schema.json, env.lock -> https://novafabric.io/schemas/environment.schema.json, replay.yaml -> https://novafabric.io/schemas/replay-policy.schema.json, redaction-proof.json -> https://novafabric.io/schemas/secret-redaction.schema.json, lineage.jsonl -> https://novafabric.io/schemas/lineage-edge.schema.json.  STATUS: this is the OAS v1.0 TARGET schema and is NOT yet in force. ADR-0034 §1 freezes a spec only when all four conditions hold; as of 2026-08-02 conditions 2 (spec doc 'Adopted') and 3 (>=3 design-partner sign-offs) are open, so the spec is in pre-freeze draft status. Producers write schema_version 0.1.0 and are validated against the packaged schema ($id .../run-capsule.schema.json). See ADR-0223.
title: RunCapsule
description: Top-level manifest (capsule.yaml) of a NovaFabric Run Capsule. One of two formats NovaFabric invents; the other is EvidenceBundle. Validates the YAML-1.2 manifest; sub-file schemas are referenced by URL.

schema_version.description: OAS v1.0 schema version. Must be 1.x.x (ADR-0034 §1).

run_id.description: Canonical 26-character ULID. Globally unique and lexicographically sortable.

created_at.description: UTC start time of the run (RFC 3339).

finished_at.description: UTC end time of the run (RFC 3339). May equal created_at for instantaneous runs.

status.description: Overall outcome of the run. 'partial' when streaming was interrupted; 'aborted' when killed by signal.

command.description: The argv that produced the run, sanitized of secrets. Empty array for SDK-driven runs.

capture_mode.description: Mechanism used to capture this run.

novafabric_version.description: Version of the NovaFabric tooling that wrote this capsule.

working_directory.description: Sanitized working directory path; home directory normalized to '~'.

host.description: OS-level host identity at capture time. Sanitized per redaction policy.

environment_ref.description: Relative path to env.lock. Always 'env.lock' in v0.1.

replay_policy_ref.description: Relative path to replay.yaml. Always 'replay.yaml' in v0.1.

trace_ref.description: Relative path to the OTel-compatible trace file.

trace_root_span_id.description: Root span ID of the trace tree in W3C trace-context format.

model_calls_ref.description: Relative path to model-calls.jsonl. Each line validates against https://novafabric.io/schemas/model-call.schema.json.

tool_calls_ref.description: Relative path to tool-calls.jsonl. Each line validates against https://novafabric.io/schemas/tool-call.schema.json.

inputs.description: Logical input artifacts. Empty array is valid.

outputs.description: Logical output artifacts. Empty array is valid.

model_call_count.description: Count of records in model-calls.jsonl. Redundant but required for cheap validation.

mutating_tool_count.description: Count of tool calls with mutates: true.

usage_totals.description: Per-usage-type roll-up over the nova.usage blocks in model-calls.jsonl (ADR-0132 D3). Pure sum; absent per-call fields are skipped, never counted as 0. Optional and additive: absent when no call reported a usage breakdown.

parent_run_id.description: If this run was triggered by another captured run, its run_id.

replay_of_run_id.description: If this run is a replay, the original run's run_id.

replay_mode.description: Required when replay_of_run_id is set. The replay mode used.

lineage_ref.description: Relative path to lineage.jsonl. Optional in v0.2; required from v0.4. Each line validates against https://novafabric.io/schemas/lineage-edge.schema.json.

attestations_ref.description: Relative path to attestations/ directory. Populated by novafabric export-evidence.

metadata.description: Free-form user labels. Values must be strings; must not contain secrets. Validators warn if any value matches a secret-detection pattern.

git.description: Git repository context at capture time. Populated when run inside a git repo.

exit_code.description: Process exit code. Present when capture_mode is 'cli-wrapper'.

error.description: Error detail when status is 'failure' or 'partial'. Sanitized for secrets.

facets.description: First-party NovaFabric evidence facets (ADR-0196). Additive and optional: a capsule without this key is valid and unchanged. Distinct from `extensions`, which carries THIRD-PARTY vendor data — an auditor must be able to tell NovaFabric-recorded evidence from a vendor annotation. The registry below is closed on purpose (ADR-0196 D2): an unregistered name is either a typo, which would silently produce a capsule missing the evidence its author believed it carried, or an unreviewed evidence surface. Each facet's internal shape is owned by its own ADR, not redefined here.

extensions.description: Vendor extensions. Keys must be reverse-DNS-prefixed (e.g. 'io.langgraph.thread').

deployment_environment.description: Optional deployment-context tag (ADR-0126): conventionally 'production' | 'staging' | 'development' | 'test', or any custom string (e.g. 'prod-eu'). Distinct from the environment lock (env.lock, ADR-0007). Absent means unknown; never written as an empty string. Recorded verbatim from an explicit source, never inferred.

environment_source.description: Provenance of deployment_environment (ADR-0126): 'cli-flag' | 'env-var' | 'sdk-arg'. Absent when deployment_environment is absent.

experiment_id.description: Stable id of the experiment the run participated in. Opaque to NovaFabric; copied verbatim.

variant_id.description: Stable id of the active arm. MAY reference a prompt version/label (ADR-0112/0113); NovaFabric records the string verbatim and never resolves it.

assignment_source.description: The EXTERNAL system that assigned the arm, recorded verbatim (e.g. 'launchdarkly', 'statsig', 'env:NOVA_VARIANT', 'upstream-router'). NovaFabric never allocates, so no value means 'NovaFabric assigned this'.

assigned_at.description: UTC timestamp of the external assignment, if the caller supplied it (RFC 3339). Never substituted with the capture time.

extensions.description: Vendor extensions; reverse-DNS keys (e.g. 'io.launchdarkly.flag_key'). Arbitrary keys allowed here only.

variant.description: Optional A/B-variant attribution (ADR-0116): which experiment and variant an EXTERNAL allocator had active for this run. Record-only — every field is copied verbatim from the caller; NovaFabric never assigns, splits, samples, or analyzes variants. Absent means no variant recorded (the common case).

session_id.description: Optional session back-reference (ADR-0122): the multi-turn conversation/workflow session this run participates in. A convenience back-reference only — the session.json manifest (session-manifest.schema.json) is the authoritative ordered index and wins on disagreement. Absent = a standalone run (the common case). NOT the parent/child distributed-run hierarchy (parent_run_id / ADR-0039).

sequence.description: Zero-based turn/step order of this run within session_id (ADR-0122). Requires session_id; advisory — the session manifest is authoritative.

allOf.$comment: ADR-0126: a non-null environment_source requires deployment_environment to be present.
ADR-0122: a sequence (turn index) is meaningless without its session — sequence requires session_id.

Ulid.description: 26-character Crockford base32 ULID. Globally unique, lexicographically sortable, time-prefixed.

SpanId.description: 16-character lowercase hex OTel span ID (W3C trace-context format).

ContentHash.description: SHA-256 content hash in sha256:<hex> form.

kind.description: How to locate the external resource at replay time.

hash.description: SHA-256 of the resource bytes at capture time.

fetched_at.description: When the resource was fetched during capture (RFC 3339).

freshness_window.description: ISO 8601 duration. Default from replay policy applies if absent.

path.description: Relative path under inputs/ or outputs/. Ignored when inline is true.

inline.description: If true, the artifact bytes are inlined in inline_value; path is ignored.

inline_value.description: UTF-8 content used when inline is true. Capped at 64 KiB; larger artifacts must use path.

produced_by_call.description: model_call_id or tool_call_id that produced this output artifact.

external.description: Present when the artifact is stored by reference rather than embedded.

cpu_count.description: Logical CPUs available to the process.

memory_bytes.description: Total memory available to the process in bytes.

gpu.description: GPU inventory. Empty array if no GPU present.

cuda.description: CUDA version, e.g. '12.4'. Absent if no CUDA.

slurm.description: SLURM context when running under a SLURM scheduler.

kubernetes.description: Kubernetes context when running in a pod.

hostname_redacted.description: True when hostname was replaced with a stable hash per secret-policy-v0; false when the user opted in to recording it.

dirty.description: True if the working tree had uncommitted changes at capture.

type.description: Exception class name or error kind, e.g. 'ToolInvocationError', 'SignalAborted'.

traceback_ref.description: Relative path under outputs/ where the full traceback is stored.
